content:
maria: Heads up — cloud billing alert: APAC (ap-northeast-1) shows a spike in 'Compute:GPU' untagged charges ~ $120k for Feb. Anyone see a rollout? :eyes:

devon: I launched a large training burst last week but I tagged the jobs with `team=research`. Not sure why instances show up unlabeled in billing export.

finance-bot: Billing export URL: https://console.cloud/reports/billing_export?range=2026-02-01_2026-02-28

lee: I noticed several ephemeral nodepools created by the autoscaler used an old node template that doesn't include the `redwood:owner` label. Those instances would miss reservation mapping.

maria: That would explain the reservation mismatch — unlabeled compute SKUs don't get matched to reserved commitments.

olivia: Quick check query for BigQuery export to find unlabeled GPU charges:
```
SELECT resource_name, sku_description, cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export`
WHERE region = 'asia-northeast1'
  AND (labels.owner IS NULL OR labels.owner = '')
  AND LOWER(sku_description) LIKE '%gpu%'
```

sam: Ran it — results show ~450k GPU minutes and ~$118k cost with NULL owner labels across multiple projects.

devon: Yikes. So reservations were on the project-level commitments but instances lacked the instance/project join label. We need to backfill.

maria: Proposed action items:
1) Backfill labels on affected instances/nodepools (owner + project_team)
2) Re-run billing mapping + request cost reclassification for Feb
3) Add admission controller / validate templates to block unlabeled nodepools
4) Finance chargeback coordination + communication to impacted teams

lee: For backfill, a quick gcloud loop (adapt per zone):
```
for id in $(gcloud compute instances list --filter='labels.owner=""' --format='value(name,zone)'); do
  name=$(echo $id | awk '{print $1}'); zone=$(echo $id | awk '{print $2}');
  gcloud compute instances add-labels $name --labels=owner=devon --zone=$zone || echo "fail $name";
done
```

devon: I'll identify which nodepools my job created and push labels. Also opening a PR to autoscaler config to inherit nodepool labels.

finance-bot: To request a backfill please submit: https://redwood.internal/finance/backfill with subject `APAC-GPU-ORPHAN` and attach the query results. Backfills are reviewed weekly.

maria: Created INFRA-4312 and assigned to @devon + @lee, due EOD Fri. :calendar:

olivia: Also flagging a mapping issue: `commit-asia-1` reservation mapping currently joins on `project` label only; if instance labels differ we miss application. Might need to join instance labels or include `nodepool` metadata.

sam: I'll escalate to billing-infra to consider instance-level joins. If mapping logic changes we can reduce future leakage.

devon: Will update this thread as I backfill and when INFRA-4312 has progress. Thanks all.

infra-bot: Incident INFRA-4312 assigned to devon,lee — status: investigating
